posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies are in absolute hell right now.

reply_texts.text:
Crazy thing to say. 

It's us who pay money to watch this who are in hell
reply_texts.author: tonydewald.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
Nah. They are a bunch of dads in their mid-30s making millions. It's been clear for a while that they are just clocking in for their paycheck and their priorities are elsewhere.

They could care less. There is zero emotion or life in that dugout.
reply_texts.author: ashleykilmer.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: People paid money to sit there in the rain and experience this. They should be studied.
reply_texts.author: thebartosz.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I can smell the vibes from Honolulu.
reply_texts.author: jamie808.bsky.social

posts.jp: フィリーズは今、地獄の真っ最中だ。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: The Orioles are 79-82, guaranteed of a losing season. If that's all ... thank you so much for following

reply_texts.text: Thanks everyone for your very kind words. They really do mean a lot. This job is nothing without readers
reply_texts.author: afkostka.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Thank you, Andy, for doing a good job covering the team and for being active on here and keeping us informed without having to go to the other place. I truly appreciate you.
reply_texts.author: lizzierie.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: thank you for covering, andy. you're a key resource for us on here and i want you to know that we all value you.
reply_texts.author: etgoch.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Thank you for everything, Andy. We fans are so lucky to have you!
reply_texts.author: kimschuss.bsky.social

posts.jp: オリオールズは79-82。負け越しが確定した。それだけで…本当にありがとうございました 🙏

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: For the third straight season, the fourth time in the past five seasons and the 14th time in 32 seasons ... Cleveland has won the AL Central title. The Guardians get a first-round bye and will host Game 1 of the ALDS next Saturday at Progressive Field.
posts.jp: 3シーズン連続、過去5シーズンで4度目、32シーズン中14度目…ガーディアンズがAL中地区制覇！ファーストラウンドはバイ。来週土曜日にプログレッシブ・フィールドでALDS第1戦をホストする。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Trea Turner just hit a ball 104 mph that drilled Griffin Jax square in the ass. It bounced to the shortstop, who threw out Turner by a half step. The Phillies have not scored in 18 innings.
posts.jp: トレア・ターナーが時速104マイルの打球を放ったがグリフィン・ジャックスのお尻に直撃。遊撃手が拾ってターナーをわずかの差でアウト。フィリーズは18回連続得点なし。

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Brewers 8, Cardinals 4. Win No. 101 guarantees the Brewers will finish with sole possession of the best record in baseball for the second straight season.
